steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Grow an overnight bacterial culture in appropriate media at an appropriate temperature.

steps.title: Expand Culture to Target Density
steps.instruction: Inoculate 1 mL of the overnight culture into 10 mL LB media and grow until the OD600 reaches 0.6-1.0.

steps.title: Harvest Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest 1.5 mL of culture (< 5x10%) by centrifugation in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3,000 rpm for 10 minutes
Discard all supernatant, using a pipette to remove remaining liquid at the bottom

steps.title: Lyse Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL freshly prepared Elution Buffer (10mM Tris-HCL pH 8.5) containing lysozyme (0.4 mg/mL for Gram-negative bacteria).

substeps.instruction: Mix by tapping gently
Incubate at room temperature for 3-5 min (for Gram-negative bacteria)
Add 400 μL Buffer LY and mix gently

steps.title: Clear DNA from Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the lysate using a DNA Clearance column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cleared lysate to a DNA Clearance column pre-inserted in a 2 mL Collection Tube
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 2 minutes
Discard the DNA Clearance column and save the flow-through

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysate for RNA binding and load it onto the RNA binding column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer flow-through to the RNA binding column
Add 0.5 volume 100% ethanol to the lysate (e.g., 250 μL ethanol for 500 μL lysate)
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 minute
Discard the collection tube with the flow-through and place the column into a new collection tube

steps.title: Wash RNA Column
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA using Buffer RB and RNA Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer RB to the column, centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 30 seconds, and discard flow-through
Add 500 µL RNA Wash Buffer (ensure ethanol was added to buffer before use), centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 30 seconds, and discard flow-through
Add another 500 µL RNA Wash Buffer, centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 30 seconds, and discard flow-through and collection tube
Place the column into a new collection tube

steps.title: Dry Column and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol and elute the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 13,000 rpm with the lid open for 1 minute
Place the column into a RNase-free 1.5 mL tube
Add 50-100 μL DEPC treated ddH2O to the column
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 2 minutes to collect RNA in the flow-through

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store the resulting RNA solution at -20 °C.
